title: Zesty Norwegian Lamb Tagine
description: A hearty and earthy Norwegian dish featuring lamb, parma ham, and root vegetables, cooked in a traditional tagine pot. This halal-friendly recipe is perfect for a cold winter's night.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the bottom of a large tagine pot over medium heat.
Add the diced parma ham and cook until crispy, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the lamb pieces and cook until browned on all sides, about 10 minutes.
Add the chopped carrots and potatoes, and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Add the prunes, cumin, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Pour in enough water to cover the ingredients and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the tagine pot, and simmer for 2.5 hours, or until the lamb is tender.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro.
Traditionally, the tagine is served with crusty bread or over couscous.
